text: This report recommends a three year multi-year license agreement between a Gala Event Producer and Exhibition Place within the Beanfield Centre.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved three license agreements with the Gala Event Producer for the Beanfield Centre for a three year term in each of 2025, 2026, and 2027 on the terms and conditions set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, the terms and conditions of the standard license agreements for Cerise Fine Catering and such other terms and conditions satisfactory to the Chief Executive Officer and the City Solicitor. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, remain confidential as it contains financial information, supplied in confidence to the Board, which, if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or…
